mesopotamian.prompt: Ancient Mesopotamia, third millennium BCE. Plucked bull-headed lyre in the style of the Lyres of Ur, a soft frame drum, a low reed pipe, and a quiet sustained drone suggesting river reeds and clay-walled temples. Instrumental only, no vocals, no spoken word, no chanting. Slow, spacious, meditative ambient bed that sits quietly under reading. Steady dynamics, no drops, no big climax, gentle fade structure so it can loop seamlessly. Approximately 90 seconds. Respectful, documentary tone; avoid cinematic cliches and pastiche.
